no-restricted-globals.message: Use useConfirm() / ConfirmDialog instead of the native confirm dialog (Issue #1113).

no-restricted-globals.name: alert
no-restricted-globals.message: Use a styled notification (e.g. Toast) instead of the native alert dialog (Issue #1113).

no-restricted-properties.message: Use useConfirm() / ConfirmDialog instead of window.confirm (Issue #1113).

no-restricted-syntax.message: i18n: モジュールスコープの const に表示文言が直書きされています。この位置では useTranslations() の t() を呼べないため英語が固定されます。`labelKey: 'nav.home'` のようにキーを持たせ、描画時に t(labelKey) で解決してください。技術的な値・キーコード表記など翻訳対象外の場合のみ eslint-disable-next-line に理由を添えて抑止してください (Issue #1271)。

Issue #1922 (§4 D4, DR4-005): ESLint 8's core no-restricted-imports only sees static import / export ... from, so a dynamic import() or require() of src/lib/tmux/** would slip past it. Same rule as the static form: go through the CLITool gateway or captureSessionOutput. There is no allowlist for this one - keep it at zero.

patterns.message: Issue #1922 (docs/design/multi-agent-state-architecture.md §4 D4): route / CLI / poller / ws must not reach tmux directly. Go through the CLITool gateway (ICLITool.startSession / sendMessage / interrupt / isRunning / killSession) or the second sanctioned gateway, captureSessionOutput / captureSessionOutputFresh in src/lib/session/cli-session.ts. The allowlist in overrides is baseline debt from Phase 1 and may only shrink - do not add to it.
